import csv,io,json,subprocess,sys,time,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('products/services/catalogue-qa'); o=r/'measured-delivery'; o.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
s=Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example').resolve(); f=(r/'fulfillment').resolve(); t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); runs={}
def run(n,a):
 start=time.monotonic_ns(); p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,*map(str,a)],capture_output=True,text=True)
 runs[n]={'command':list(map(str,a)),'seconds':(time.monotonic_ns()-start)/1e9,'exit':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}; return p
v=f/'synthetic-v.csv'; i=f/'synthetic-i.csv'; prod=f/'synthetic-ours.csv'
assert run('input_validation',[s/'transform.py','--variants',v,'--images',i,'--out',t/'ours.csv','--report',t/'report.json']).returncode==0
p=run('paired_valid',[s/'verify_example.py',v,i,prod]); good=json.loads(p.stdout); assert p.returncode==0
rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(prod.read_text()))); fields=list(rows[0]); target=rows[0]; original=target['Barcodes']; target['Barcodes']='9999999999999'
with (t/'defect.csv').open('w',newline='') as h:
 w=csv.DictWriter(h,fieldnames=fields,lineterminator='\n'); w.writeheader(); w.writerows(rows)
p=run('paired_barcode_defect',[s/'verify_example.py',v,i,t/'defect.csv']); bad=json.loads(p.stdout); assert p.returncode==1 and any('identifiers_preserved' in k for k in bad['failed'])
src=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(v.read_text()))); source=next(x for x in src if x['sku']==target['SKU'])
loc={'SKU':target['SKU'],'produced_data_record':1,'field':'Barcodes','source':source['barcode'],'baseline':original,'observed':target['Barcodes']}
assert run('existing_duplicate_image_location_suite',[r/'row-location/run_checks.py']).returncode==0
suite=json.loads((r/'row-location/check-results.json').read_text()); assert suite['all_pass']
assert len(src)<=20
rule='CAD60 unvalidated hypothesis; <=20 variant rows counted at intake, non-personal pasted text, source/images plus produced rows for preservation checks, one bounded revision. Input-only receives validation only. Operator creates and accepts paid order. Refuse store access, import guarantees or larger scope. The proposed 100-row expansion is unsupported.'
res={'label':'SYNTHETIC ONLY','runs':runs,'variant_rows':len(src),'valid':good,'known_defect':bad,'located_defect':loc,'row_location_suite':{'passed':suite['passed'],'total':suite['total']},'timing_limits':'Single monotonic subprocess durations include startup; suite contains multiple cases. Not human labor or arbitrary buyer-file performance.','unmeasured':['acquisition','intake interpretation','manual report review','revision','operator administration'],'effort_assumptions':'Prior 2–5.25 total hours remain assumptions, not validated by runtime.','acceptance_rule':rule,'failed_attempts':{'TASK-179434476212':'Wrong assumed column names caused StopIteration; read actual headers.','TASK-179434476213':'Shortened expected check name caused assertion; read actual verifier key.'},'not_established':['customer delivery','demand','orders','payment','profit','revenue']}
(o/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(res,indent=2))
text='Synthetic catalogue QA delivery report\nProduced by autonomous AI agents / Produit par des agents d’IA autonomes.\nValid pair: '+str(sum(good['checks'].values()))+'/'+str(len(good['checks']))+' checks passed, '+str(len(src))+' variants.\nKnown defect: '+json.dumps(loc)+'; failed checks: '+', '.join(bad['failed'])+'. Located by SKU comparison, not by automatic verifier row output.\nExisting duplicate-image row locator suite: '+str(suite['passed'])+'/'+str(suite['total'])+'. See results.json for actual commands, stdout, exits and timing.\nHeader/LF checks concern our documented subset, not Shopify acceptance. No import or image retrieval tested.\n'+rule+'\nAcquisition, interpretation, revision and administration unmeasured; runtime is not labor or profit.\nFR : Répétition synthétique seulement; erreur de code-barres repérée par SKU. Conservation et correspondance des images exigent les lignes produites; sinon validation des entrées seulement. Maximum 20 variantes, CAD60 hypothétique, une révision limitée et acceptation administrative préalable. Aucun client, paiement ou revenu vérifié.\n'
(o/'delivery-report.md').write_text(text)
print(json.dumps(res))
